objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed document in the P&R system that progresses through creation, editing, release, and archiving lifecycle states

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Document identifier and title composed of abbreviation, number, and descriptive name

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state including Editing, Released, Archived, or Out of Force

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date when the document becomes valid

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date when the document validity expires

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: The document body and text

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original or translated language of the document

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled document that is released together with its main document and triggers versioning of the main document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle state including Editing, Released, or Archived

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number linked to main document version

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A document supplement not subject to the release cycle of the main document and not triggering versioning

attributes.name: published
attributes.description: Whether the additional info is currently visible to readers

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposed modification to an existing document managed independently from the document version history

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state including Proposed, Scheduled, or Completed

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Details of the proposed change

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: A request to extend the validity period of a document after the initial validity term expires

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state including Pending, Approved, or Deleted

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: A request to declare a document invalid and archive it when it no longer has validity

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state including Pending, Approved, or Completed

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: A request to restore a previously archived and invalidated document to active use

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current state including Pending or Approved

objs.name: user
objs.description: A person who interacts with documents in roles such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, or Translator

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, or Translator

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identity of the user

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A collection of users assigned to distribution lists or authorization groups for document access

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Group identifier and name

attributes.name: purpose
attributes.description: Function such as Reader, Author, Archive, or distribution-specific group

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of users or user groups designated to receive document notifications or requests

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution such as Email or Acknowledgement

attributes.name: recipients
attributes.description: Users or user groups included in the distribution

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Attach a new document object to the system with selection of document type and optional template

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: The classification selected for the new document

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify the content of a document using the embedded editing client

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Update metadata and attributes of a document such as authorization, scope, or references

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert document from source format to PDF for web display

evts.name: submit_for_review
evts.description: Initiate the workflow to start the 3-step approval process beginning with author signature

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Check document content and properties according to technical and formal criteria

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: Sign and release a document to make it visible to readers

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make a released document visible to authorized readers

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Apply electronic signature to document by workflow participant

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: Add a controlled document attachment that will be released with the main document

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an attachment for archiving at next main document release

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: Add a non-controlled supplement to a document

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a proposed modification to a document without affecting content or version

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Plan implementation of a change proposal to trigger a new document version

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Document the editing of a change proposal for closure

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatically generate a new version when changes trigger versioning

evts.name: request_validity_extension
evts.description: System-generated request when document reaches 30 days before validity expiration

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Approve extension of document validity period for an additional term

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to invalidate and archive a document with no additional validity

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Set a document to Out of Force status and revoke all authorizations except archive group

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate a request to restore a previously invalidated document

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore an archived document to active status with new version

evts.name: distribute_document
evts.description: Send document notification or acknowledgement request to recipients via distribution list

evts.name: acknowledge_document
evts.description: Confirm receipt and understanding of a document by a designated recipient

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create a language version of a released document for translation

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check the accuracy and quality of a translated document version

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve a translated document version to make it visible in the target language

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Set read and write permissions for users or user groups on a document

o2o.description: A document contains attachments which are released and archived together with the main document
A document can include additional information that supplements but does not control the main document
A change proposal belongs to and references a specific document
A validity extension request is linked to a document to be validity-checked
An override request references a document to be invalidated
A reactivation request specifies which archived document to restore
A document maintains a distribution list to control notifications and access
Users are members of user groups for authorization and distribution purposes
User groups are assigned to distribution lists to receive document notifications

o2e.description: Create Document is performed on a Document object
Edit Document Content modifies a Document object
Edit Document Properties modifies a Document object
Convert to PDF transforms a Document object
Submit for Review initiates workflow on a Document object
Review Document checks a Document object
Approve Document releases a Document object
Publish Document makes a Document object visible
Sign Document applies electronic signature to a Document object
Create Attachment creates an Attachment object for a Document
Archive Attachment marks an Attachment object for archiving
Create Additional Info creates an Additional Info object
Create Change Proposal creates a Change Proposal object
Schedule Change Proposal plans implementation of a Change Proposal
Complete Change Proposal closes a Change Proposal object
Create New Version generates a new version of a Document object
Request Validity Extension creates a Validity Extension Request
Extend Validity approves a Validity Extension Request
Create Override Request creates an Override Request object
Declare Override processes an Override Request
Create Reactivation Request creates a Reactivation Request object
Reactivate Document processes a Reactivation Request
Distribute Document sends notifications using a Document object
Acknowledge Document confirms receipt by a User
Translate Document creates a language version of a Document object
Review Translation checks a translated Document version
Release Translation approves a translated Document version
Assign Authorization grants permissions to a User or User Group
Assign Authorization grants permissions to a User Group
